capture_validation.authority: Existing capture_complete, result-index and correction-entry receipts. Their declared payload SHA is bound across receipts; the observer did not recompute payload SHA or repeat field/camera audits.

requested.limitation: Execution candidate only; requires measured contact/control/sensor/task acceptance. Native random draws are batch-owned, not independent lane streams or backend-exact replay.

execution_backend.note: Constructed configuration, not live task acceptance

renderer_resources.scope: Process-local renderer capacity; no image quality, camera calibration or physics change

batch_configuration.ordering: Role-grouped whole waves; no dynamic recycling; all opportunities retained

wall_and_throughput.denominator: This first A wave execution/finalization seconds plus its separately recorded sequential admission seconds. Excludes process/model/Kit startup and unrelated stages; overlapping lane lifetimes are never summed.

largest_recorded_wave_component.name: environment_s
largest_recorded_wave_component.scope: Timed isolated.step call, including native stepping and associated sensor/render work; this is not a pure-physics or isolated-GPU measurement.

capture_writer.byte_scope: owned payload arrays, including retained buffers; excludes bounded flush/compressor scratch
capture_writer.verification_scope: Bound includes queued and running closed-file tasks; only paths/metadata sent. Spawned verifier decode buffers/RSS are separate from payload byte budget.
capture_writer.queue_scope: Shared writer jobs, not trajectories or observations; excludes the currently executing job
capture_writer.memory_scope: Owned payload and retained buffers, not process RAM; excludes source inputs and HDF5/compressor scratch

vision_execution.scope: Batch aggregate; padding duplicates current views only, is discarded, and is not an observation or training exposure

wave_profile.admission_scope: Sum of sequential admit_capture calls after wave execution; includes provenance, source-label/camera checks and admission receipt writes; excluded from wave seconds

timing_limits: Wave profile components and per-capture worker verification/append/queue times overlap. Do not add them to obtain elapsed time.
Observed effective throughput describes only this 16-opportunity A cohort. It is not a causal comparison against older CPU/GPU batches with different cohorts or schedules.
Successful recovery after expert takeover is effective training data, not autonomous student task success.

payload.byte_semantics: Logical bytes read by SHA; OS physical disk traffic is not measured

admission_memo_snapshot.semantic_scope: Numeric/action/history/camera audits still run for every capture; only immutable file and pair metadata reused
